fields.label: Warehouse
fields.description: Warehouse name. Empty = default warehouse. Unique per vendor+product+warehouse enforced in controller.

fields.label: Default Warehouse
fields.description: Row for the default (fallback) warehouse. Stock here is the aggregate if no warehouse is specified.

fields.label: Available Qty
fields.description: What customers can buy right now — decremented on checkout reservation

fields.label: Reserved Qty
fields.description: Held by orders that are placed but not yet confirmed delivered

fields.label: Last Known Qty
fields.description: Qty at last successful reconciliation. Used as staleness guard.

fields.label: Last Sync At
fields.description: When the vendor last pushed a stock event for this product

fields.label: Last Event ID
fields.description: UUID of the last processed stock event for idempotency

fields.label: Last Event Seq
fields.description: Monotonically increasing sequence of the last processed event
